: Discover a fascinating piece of industrial history with this vintage lot of glass telephone/telegraph insulators, including a sturdy metal mounting bracket. These unique collectibles feature classic clear glass insulators from the renowned Whitall Tatum No.2 series, as well as Hemingray models, all in used vintage condition. Each insulator displays distinct character, with embossed branding and minor surface wear that adds to their authentic charm. The included metal mounting bracket makes it easy to display these as a conversation-worthy centerpiece in any industrial-inspired decor, or to start a collection. Glass insulators make striking paperweights, shelf art, or functional accents for creative reuse. Trust in the enduring craftsmanship and authenticity of original U.S. utility artifactsperfect for collectors, decorators, or vintage enthusiasts seeking genuine historical items. All items shown in photos are included, making this a versatile and decorative set.
